To improve the quality of performing Internal Audit Services and Risk activities, GAR is seeking opportunities to learn about trends and best practices as well as emerging topics, risks, and changes that may affect the organization for which they work and the Internal Audit profession. The training was identified to ensure Information Technology (IT) Auditors maintain the required competence in line with Institution of Internal Auditors (IIA) standards and continuous professional development requirements.
